THERMOCOUPLES 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 14 May 1962, stftcr the draft, tinalized by the Electrical Instruments 
and Meters Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electro- 
technical Division Council. 

0.2 In the preparation of this Standard, assistance has been derived from 
B.S. 1826: 1952 Reference Tables for Thermocouples (Platinum/Rhodium 
V Platinum) issued by the British Standards Institution. 

0.3 Reference tables for other the^'mocouple materials are giyen in the 
following Indian Standards: 

IS : 2054- 1%2 Reference Tables for Nigkel/Chroicium — Nickel/ 
Aluminium Thermocouples 

IS : 2056-l%2 Reference Tables for Copper — Constantan 
Thermocouples 

IS : 2057-l%2 Reference Tables for Iron — Constantan 
Thermocouples 

0.4 The general requirements and tests applicable to thermocouple pyro- 
meters arc covered, by IS : 2053-1 %2 Specification for Thermocouple 
Pyrometers. 



1. SCOPE 

1,1 This standard gives the reference tables of cmf — temperature relation- 
ship for platinum /rhodium — platinum thermocouples. 



ISt 2055-1962 

2. REFERENCE TABLES 

2.1 The reference tables for platinum /rhodium — platinum thermo- 
couples are given as follows: 

Tabic I Millivolts v Degrees C ) lor placinum/13 percent rhodium 
Table II Degrees C v Millivolts / — platinum thermocouples 

Table III Millivolts v Degrees C I for platinum/ 10 percent rhodium 
Table IV Degrees C v Millivolts f — platinum thermocouples 

2.2 Reference Tables are leased upon the International Temperature Scale 
1948 and the Absolute Volt. 

3. TOLERANCES 

3.1 The calibration of the thermocouple shall agree v^ith the values given 
in Tabic 1 and Tabic 2 within the following tolerances : 

Temperature Range, "C Tolerances 

to 6 00 ± 3°C 

Above 600 ± 0*5 percent
